audience: customer support and sales teams who text customers from a shared inbox in Textline

useCases.title: Find open conversations in an inbox
useCases.text: The AI lists the conversations of a department with contact and resolved status, with an optional keyword search. You see which conversations are unresolved.

useCases.title: Read the conversation with a phone number
useCases.text: The AI opens the conversation with a number and reads its messages, internal whispers and resolve or transfer events.

useCases.title: Look up contacts, agents and survey answers
useCases.text: The AI searches the address book for contacts with tags and notes, lists agents with availability, and lists the responses to a survey.

useCases.title: Report on conversations in a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists a department's conversations by created or updated time and status with a total count, then reads the posts of one conversation.

useCases.title: Reply, add a note, resolve or hand over a conversation
useCases.text: The AI sends a text to one contact, adds an internal note, resolves a conversation with a disposition, or transfers it to another agent.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact in the address book
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact, or changes a contact's name, email, notes, tags or custom fields. Nothing is sent to the contact.
